headline: Container registry scanning regrouped by vendor; Identity Profile version floor drops to XSIAM 3.5
summary_md:
- Registry scanning is now licensed by **either** the Cloud Posture Security or the Cloud Runtime Security add-on, where before only Cloud Runtime Security qualified.
- Twelve container registry pages moved out of Cloud Posture and Runtime Security data sources into per-vendor folders under Vendor-specific data sources and connectors.
- **Identity Profile** now names Cortex XSIAM 3.5, Cortex XDR 5.1 or Cortex Cloud Runtime 2.1 instead of a flat XSIAM 3.6 floor, and is explicitly unavailable on XSIAM 2.x and XDR 3.x.
- Ubuntu 26 gains supported-kernel pages on x86_64 and aarch64 at agent 9.1.0, alongside newly certified kernels across AlmaLinux, Rocky, RHEL, Oracle, Amazon Linux and Ubuntu.
- Most of the day's 448 files are an editorial pass: 182 XSIAM pages and most of the 75 Development Guide pages had descriptions and headings rewritten without changing meaning.

highlights.title: Container registry scanning is now included with the Cloud Posture Security add-on as well
highlights.detail: The License type note gained "the Cloud Posture Security or" before "the Cloud Runtime Security add-on", widening which products cover the feature.

highlights.title: The six registry connectors moved to per-vendor folders, breaking their old URLs
highlights.detail: Docker Hub, Docker V2, GitLab, Harbor, JFrog and Sonatype Nexus and their manage- subpages left container-registry-scanning/ for vendor-specific-data-sources-and-connectors/<vendor>/.

highlights.title: Identity Profile prerequisites were restated across three products
highlights.detail: "Cortex XSIAM 3.6 or later" became "Cortex XSIAM 3.5, Cortex XDR 5.1, or Cortex Cloud Runtime 2.1 or later", still requiring agent 9.1 and the ITDR add-on.

highlights.title: Ubuntu 26 is now a supported kernel platform
highlights.detail: New x86_64 and aarch64 pages list 7.0.0-14-generic onward at a 9.1.0 minimum agent version, taking the Linux Kernel Versions book from 100 to 102 pages.

highlights.title: The Development Guide's Alerts page is now Issues
highlights.detail: Alert fields, layouts, layout rules and mappers were all restated as issue equivalents; the page keeps its alerts.md path, so only the title and body moved.

highlights.title: The Broker VM registry scanner page now links to broken-reference six times
highlights.detail: Its links to the six connector pages were replaced with the literal placeholder broken-reference rather than repointed at the new vendor paths.

items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/cortex-xsia: Licence note now covers the Cloud Posture Security add-on too, and the connector list points into the new vendor folders.
All six connector links became the placeholder broken-reference when the targets moved.
items.xsiam/protect-your-endpoints/endpoint-se: Version floor restated as XSIAM 3.5 / XDR 5.1 / Cloud Runtime 2.1, excluded on XSIAM 2.x and XDR 3.x, prerequisites now a bulleted hint.
items.xsiam/detect-investigate-and-respond-to-: Identity Profile described as available on Windows endpoints rather than as a Windows-only profile.
items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/cortex-xsia: New page, a title-only stub that parents the two Docker connector pages in the navigation.
New title-only stub parenting the Harbor registry connector page.
New title-only stub parenting the JFrog container registry connector page.
New title-only stub parenting the Sonatype Nexus registry connector page.
The pointer to the Docker Hub connector for public and private repositories is now formatted as a Note hint.
items.developer/cortex-xsiam-development-guide: Retitled from Alerts to Issues, with alert fields, layouts, layout rules and mappers restated as issue equivalents.
items.linux-kernels/ubuntu/x86_64/26: New page listing Ubuntu 26 x86_64 kernels from 7.0.0-14-generic, minimum agent 9.1.0.
items.linux-kernels/ubuntu/aarch64/26: New page listing Ubuntu 26 aarch64 kernels from 7.0.0-14-generic, minimum agent 9.1.0.
items.linux-kernels/oracle-linux/x86_64/9: Adds 43 certified el9_2, el9_4 and el9_6 kernels at content 2390-40333 and 2400-40648.
items.linux-kernels/red-hat-enterprise-linux-r: Adds 26 el10_0 and el10_2 kernels, minimum agent 8.7.1.
items.linux-kernels/amazon-linux-2023/x86_64/2: Two kernels added (6.1.180-225.360 and 6.12.100-125.179); the rest of the table diff is column reflow.
